initializer: shared single-path training-frequency proposal, charged in every mode
minibatch_examples: original task batch, seed-1 example shuffle, retain tail and all supervised positions
independent_update: decoder projection, fresh routing gradient, then up to eight forward backtracking checks from 0.1
depth_selection: first depth in [0,1,2,4] with training CE <= 1e-8, else smallest training CE; ties keep first
primary_pass: original selected split exact sequences >= 99 percent
all_splits_pass: every original nontraining split exact sequences >= 99 percent
transformer_comparison: original manifest historical seed-one reference only; fresh matched comparison remains separate
